data.body: **[P2] Reuse the decorated handler across warm invocations.** Rebuilding `durable_execution()` for every runtime request prevents the warm success/failure/replay cases from exercising decorator-scoped SDK state. A regression that caches the first plugin on the decorated wrapper would still receive a fresh wrapper per request here and pass the isolation assertions. Keep one decorated handler per view for the process lifetime, supply the diagnostic trace through invocation-scoped context, and verify repeated requests through that same wrapper.
